title: Assessment Failure: Test Coverage (Category C)
body: Grade: 2/10. Test coverage is critically low. Most of the codebase is untested. Action required: Implement tests for `UnifiedToolsLauncher.py`, `src/tools`, and core utilities. Enforce coverage in CI.

title: Assessment Failure: Error Handling (Category D)
body: Grade: 4/10. Error handling is inconsistent and CI masks failures. Action required: Remove `|| echo` from CI workflows to expose real errors. Replace bare `except:` blocks.

title: Assessment Failure: CI/CD (Category H)
body: Grade: 4/10. CI pipeline is unreliable due to 'False Green' configuration. Action required: Fix `ci-standard.yml` to fail on errors. Add deployment steps.

title: Assessment Failure: Data Handling (Category K)
body: Grade: 4/10. Primitive data handling with manual file I/O and no schema validation. Action required: Introduce a Data Access Layer and use Pydantic for validation.

title: Assessment Failure: Logging (Category L)
body: Grade: 3/10. Excessive use of `print()` (~394 calls) instead of `logging`. Action required: Migrate `print` statements to `logger` calls and enforce via linter.

title: Assessment Failure: Scalability (Category N)
body: Grade: 4/10. Monolithic architecture limits scalability. Action required: Refactor `Data_Processor_r0.py` and implement chunked data processing.
